about: The watch-page checks' materials (design feature-logs/watch-page-shell/design.md §5 S0b 「素材与前置条件」): online ids, each with what was checked and the answer that shows it, and the offline snapshots. Read by the field tables (run.args, run.profile) and the later S0b parts. The online ids were checked against bilibili's public web API with no login and no cookies (python urllib, user-agent "Dart/3.6 (dart:io)" as the app sends; a browser user-agent without cookies gets HTTP 412), 4-6 s between requests, about 35 in all, from this machine (ip_region PT). The raw answers were not kept: each item quotes the values that show it, copied from them by script.

statuses.confirmed: the API shows the property the design asks for, unlogged
statuses.unconfirmed: a candidate that a cookieless request could not show (not a login matter): confirm on the check's first run

login: never: every run has a new, logged-out profile (run.ps1 makes and deletes one per run; design wp5#14)
